Uhm…
So should I really throw bot parts out?
They are an illegal item with today’s law, so I could get in trouble for that…
All it takes for me to get fucked is some snitching garbage man.
On the other hand how would they know it was me that threw it out?
What am I supposed to do? If I keep getting more and more of these I will run out of places to hide them in.
